name: Simply Cheetos Puffs (White Cheddar, Non-GMO)
whyItWorks: Baked with organic non-GMO cornmeal and real aged white cheddar cheese, with zero artificial colors or preservatives. The puffs disintegrate rapidly in the mouth into smooth starch, leaving zero sharp fragments.
